messages:
sam: PR #4172 merge blocked — integration failing intermittently on shard-5. Reruns sometimes pass, sometimes fail. Anyone able to take a quick look or bisect? Link: https://build.redwood/prime/4172 :eyes:

maria: I can run a targeted rerun on shard-5 now. If it fails consistently we should bisect. Want me to kick it? :+1:

sam: Please, go ahead. If it passes twice we'll consider updating the snapshot; if it flakes again we'll bisect.

ci-bot: buildkite: PR #4172 — shard-5 failed: test_integration_kv_eviction (timeout at 00:12:43). Logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/4172/shard-5

maria: kicked targeted rerun:
```
/ci rerun --pr 4172 --shard 5 --targeted
```

maria: rerun 1 passed :tada: starting rerun 2

maria: rerun 2 failed same test, timeout.

ryan: ok that's reproducible on shard-5. I can bisect within the hour. Any recent changes touch kv eviction/backpressure? @sophia?

sophia: there's a tiny change in kv-client retry logic in #4129 that landed yesterday — could be related but not sure. :thinking_face:

ryan: I'll bisect between main@d4f3..HEAD and report back. If anyone can assign me PR to run quick local reproducer, drop instructions.

sam: dropping repro steps in thread: run integration with -k kv_eviction on a machine with 32GB mem, seq len ~2048.

ryan: got it. starting bisect now. Will post failing commit range and suggested remediation.

nora: if bisect blocks merge for >2h, we can approve a snapshot update as short-term if the flakiness is isolated to shard-5 only. ping me to escalate.

maria: noted. I'll keep an eye on reruns meanwhile.

ci-bot: buildkite: PR #4172 — targeted rerun complete: 1 pass, 1 fail. Marking for bisect.

sam: thanks everyone. tagging this thread with #merge-hold and adding to PR description: 'merge held: flaky integ on shard-5; bisect in progress'.

ryan: bisect found probable culprit: commit 9b3f7a2 (kv-client: adjust backoff). I can open a revert PR and run full matrix.

sophia: good catch. If revert fixes, let's ship revert + follow-up test hardening.

nora: acknowledged — if revert fixes in CI, we can fast-track approval. :white_check_mark:

sam: we'll follow up with postmortem once resolved. Thanks all.
